dish.note: Mint, lime and cloudy apple over crushed ice, topped with soda.
dish.how: Gently muddle the mint leaves with the syrup and lime juice in a jug, without shredding the mint. Add the apple juice and divide between glasses filled with crushed ice. Top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig.
dish.make_ahead: Squeeze the lime juice up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; muddle, add the apple juice and top with soda water to order

steps.text: Gently muddle the mint leaves with the syrup and lime juice in a jug, without shredding the mint.
Add the apple juice and divide between glasses filled with crushed ice.
Top with soda water, stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig.
